status: Prepared listing values; enter them in the Claude portal (claude.ai/directory/manage), not a portal API payload
name: AQUA IDP
description: AQUA IDP (Intelligent Document Processing) helps people applying to funding, jobs, colleges and grants preserve application sources, organize their questions, and build a bank of user-approved answers for reuse. It prepares complete Markdown drafts for review. It also connects to AQUA's public, read-only program catalog to find programs, their questions, and similar questions across programs. It accesses only files or URLs the user provides, plus that public catalog; it has no independent access to private accounts. A durable bank requires a writable local folder and Python 3. It does not approve answers, submit forms, or guarantee acceptance. Optional beta diagnostics send limited technical metadata only after the user opts in.
availability_preference: All countries the Claude portal supports
reviewer_access: No test credentials are needed. The catalog MCP is anonymous and read-only: connect https://aquaidp.xyz/mcp with No sign in and run any hub_* tool. The answer-bank skill runs locally with Python 3 in a folder the reviewer chooses.
slug_status: Availability not checked; becomes permanent after publication
release_notes: First Claude package (0.1.16), built from the AQUA IDP ChatGPT/Codex plugin. Bundles the run-aqua skill (local answer bank: archive, index, reuse approved answers, Markdown drafts) and AQUA's hosted read-only program catalog MCP (https://aquaidp.xyz/mcp, 11 tools, no account).
